battle.name: 伊比利亞-亞美尼亞戰爭
battle.brief: 公元五十年起，高加索南麓的伊比利亞王國與亞美尼亞王國為王位繼承與山隘控制大打出手，五十一年拉達米斯托斯圍攻加爾尼堡最為激烈。卡面的斯巴達長矛屬公元前八世紀的希臘方陣工藝，與本役相隔八百五十餘年，不會出現在堡下；當年刺擊用的是伊比利亞的馬其頓式長矛與羅馬軍團的短柄投槍。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 這場戰爭在高加索東段捲入四家：伊比利亞王國、亞美尼亞王國、羅馬帝國、帕提亞帝國；名稱裡的「伊比利亞」指高加索的卡爾特利，不是西班牙那個伊比利亞半島。伊比利亞王國以姆茨赫塔為都，王室是法爾納瓦茲家系，公元前一世紀本都王密梯里達斯六世在這一帶安插客戶王，把希臘化的王權與兵制留了下來；首都周邊的平坦河谷既是農耕區，也是通往北高加索與裏海的門戶，王室的步兵因此帶著馬其頓方陣的色彩。亞美尼亞王國以阿爾塔克薩塔為都，早期是阿爾塔沙德世系，公元前一世紀末淪為羅馬附庸，晚期王位由羅馬扶植的法爾納瓦茲系與亞美尼亞的提格蘭系互相婚配，混成一個王朝；血脈上的混合正是本場衝突的核心變量。羅馬在此並非以征服者身分出現，而是以宗主兼仲裁者的身分操作：它把伊比利亞與亞美尼亞都當成對付帕提亞的閘門，任何一方坐大，另一方就必須被壓制；皇帝克勞狄在位時，東方前線由卡帕多細亞總督、亞細亞行省總督與安提基拉駐軍分掌。帕提亞帝國則以「萬王之王」的名分自居，亞美尼亞與它壤鄰相接，牧場與商道爭奪從未中斷，五十年代帕提亞終於以出兵的方式把亞美尼亞變成自己與羅馬角力的棋子。整體而言，這是羅馬—帕提亞長期對抗在高加索東段的一個回合，橫跨公元三十五年到五十五年，卡面所標的公元五十年正落在其中最激烈的一段。
countriesEn: This conflict drew four parties into the eastern Caucasus: the Kingdom of Iberia, the Kingdom of Armenia, the Roman Empire and the Parthian Empire. The Iberia in the name is the Caucasian kingdom of Kartli, not the Iberian peninsula of Spain. The Iberian kingdom had its capital at Mtskheta and its ruling house was the Pharnavazid line; in the first century BC, when Mithridates VI of Pontus set client kings over this country, he left behind a Hellenised kingship and a Hellenised way of fighting. The open valley country around the capital was at once farmland and the gateway to the northern Caucasus and the Caspian, and the infantry of the royal house therefore carried the colour of the Macedonian phalanx. The Kingdom of Armenia had its capital at Artaxata and was at first the Artaxiad line; by the end of the first century BC it too had become a Roman client, and later its throne was filled by mutual intermarriage between the Pharnavazids whom Rome propped up and the Tigranid line of Armenia, producing a mixed dynasty. That mixture of blood was the central variable in this war. Rome did not appear here as a conqueror but as a patron and arbiter: it treated both Iberia and Armenia as gates against Parthia, so that whichever side grew too large had to be put down. Under the emperor Claudius the eastern front was divided between the governor of Cappadocia, the proconsul of Asia and the garrison of Antioch. The Parthian empire, for its part, claimed the title of King of Kings, bordered Armenia directly, and had never stopped competing for pastures and trade roads; in the fifties Parthia finally took the field and turned Armenia into a pawn in its own quarrel with Rome. In the larger picture this was one round of the long Roman–Parthian struggle on the eastern Caucasian frontier, running from AD 35 to AD 55, and the year AD 50 printed on the card falls in the fiercest stretch of it.
people: 拉達米斯托斯是本役最關鍵的人物。他是伊比利亞國王法爾薩曼斯一世之子，母親出自亞美尼亞王提格蘭四世，因此他同時握有兩國王族的血脈，本身就是那個混合王朝的產物；他的妹妹澤諾比亞嫁入亞美尼亞做了阿爾塔克薩塔的王后，於是他也把自己視為亞美尼亞王位的正統繼承者。公元五十年前後，他與兄弟密梯里達斯一同向亞美尼亞推進，五十一年的加爾尼之圍就是他指揮的戰役；五十二年之後他兩度登上亞美尼亞王位（五十一與五十四年），五十八年死於伊比利亞。密梯里達斯是拉達米斯托斯的兄弟，也是亞美尼亞國王（三十五年與四十二年在位），加爾尼之圍同樣有他參與，他死在戰局未決之時。澤諾比亞是拉達米斯托斯的妹妹兼妻子，她以繼母身分排擠亞美尼亞王提格朗，逼得這位羅馬扶持的少年王位流亡羅馬；後世繪畫反覆表現她被推入阿拉克塞斯河、又被牧人救起的一段。亞美尼亞方面還有提里達底一世，他後來接替拉達米斯托斯的名分，在五十八至六十三年的羅馬—帕提亞戰爭中率軍到羅馬朝覲並受冠。羅馬方面的主導者是皇帝克勞狄與東方將領：公元四十七年起出任卡帕多細亞總督的科布盧在亞美尼亞歸附與帕提亞邊境上做過關鍵周旋，亞細亞行省總督安提斯提烏斯·維圖斯與卡帕多細亞的佩圖斯則在五十年代初分掌軍政。帕提亞方面是國王沃洛加西斯一世，他在五十五年出兵，開啟了此後的亞美尼亞戰爭。
peopleEn: The decisive figure of the war was Rhadamistus. He was a son of the Iberian king Pharasmanes I, and his mother was a daughter of the Armenian king Tigranes IV, so he carried the blood of both royal houses and was himself the product of that mixed dynasty. His sister Zenobia had married into Armenia and become queen at Artaxata, and he therefore claimed the Armenian throne as a legitimate heir. Around AD 50 he advanced into Armenia together with his brother Mithridates, and the siege of Garni in AD 51 was fought under his command. He twice reached the Armenian throne, in AD 51 and again in AD 54, and he died in Iberia in AD 58. Mithridates was his brother and also king of Armenia, reigning in AD 35 and AD 42; he took part in the siege of Garni and died before the business was settled. Zenobia was Rhadamistus's sister and at the same time his wife; it was she who, as stepmother, squeezed out the young Armenian king Tigranes and drove him into exile at Rome. Later painters returned again and again to the scene in which she was thrown into the Araxes and rescued by shepherds. On the Armenian side there was also Tiridates I, who later took over Rhadamistus's title and in the Roman–Parthian War of 58–63 came to Rome with his army and was crowned there. On the Roman side the leading figures were the emperor Claudius and the eastern generals: Corbulo, who became governor of Cappadocia in AD 47, handled the critical manoeuvres over the submission of Armenia and the Parthian frontier, while Gaius Antistius Vetus, proconsul of Asia, and Paetus of Cappadocia divided the civil and military command in the early fifties. On the Parthian side stood the king Vologases I, who put his army into the field in AD 55 and so opened the Armenian war that followed.
kits: 卡面這件斯巴達長矛（dory）是公元前八世紀希臘人的方陣兵器：兩米長的木桿，前端裝葉形青銅矛頭，槍尾再套一圈銅套。它靠方陣的縱深與盾牆把個人的刺擊累積成集體的推力，所以說它比劍更早決定誰站得住；但它與公元五十年相隔八百五十餘年，不可能出現在加爾尼堡下，同時代真正在場的兵器另有其物。伊比利亞步兵承襲本都—馬其頓的方陣傳統，用的是比多利安式更長的方陣長矛（sarissa 式），配小圓盾並大量使用標槍；密梯里達斯六世留下的王國一向被視為馬其頓化的亞美尼亞與高加索諸邦，其刺擊武器正是在這條線上從希臘的 dory 逐步加長而成，卡面的這件兵器正是譜系的源頭之一。亞美尼亞步兵用長矛配輕式皮甲，弓兵比例不低，騎兵在作戰中佔比很高，帕提亞式的馬弓騎兵是全軍最能打的部分。羅馬方面，軍團步兵用短柄投槍（pilus）配大矩形盾（scutum）與短劍，輔助軍用長矛、橢圓盾與短刺刀，遠程火力交給弓兵隊與克里特弓手，騎兵則以卡帕多細亞、亞細亞的本地馬為主，弓與矛的配合是他們的看家本領。攻城器械方面，加爾尼堡依山勢築壘，外有圍牆與壕溝，圍城方靠封鎖谷口、切斷水源與道路、逼近包圍作戰；傳世記載沒有留下雙方使用攻城塔或撞車的細節，攻守之別幾乎全在耐力與糧秣，而高加索的冬季雪封山道，逼得所有行動都擠在春夏兩季。
kitsEn: The Spartan dory on the card is a phalanx weapon of the eighth century BC Greeks: a two-metre wooden shaft with a leaf-shaped bronze head at the front and a bronze collar at the butt. It turned the stabbing of individuals into the collective push of a formation by the depth of the phalanx and the shield wall, which is why it was the spear and not the sword that decided who kept their feet. It stands more than eight hundred and fifty years away from AD 50, however, and could not have stood below the walls of Garni; the weapons actually present on that ground were quite different. The Iberian infantry followed the Pontic–Macedonian phalanx tradition and used the longer sarissa-type spear of the phalanx, with small round shields and a good deal of javelin work; the kingdom left behind by Mithridates VI was always regarded as the Macedonianised Armenia of the Caucasian states, and its thrusting weapon had simply grown longer by degrees along the line that starts with the Greek dory, so the weapon on the card stands at the head of that pedigree. Armenian infantry used long spears with light leather armour, the proportion of archers was not low, and cavalry played a large part in operations, the Parthian-style mounted bowmen being the most formidable arm in the whole army. The Romans were armed as follows: legionary infantry with the short-shafted pilum, the large rectangular scutum and the gladius; auxiliaries with long spears, oval shields and a short side-knife; the long-range work was given to units of archers and to Cretan bowmen, while the cavalry rode the local horses of Cappadocia and Asia Minor, and the combination of bow and spear was their specialty. As for siege equipment, the fortress of Garni was built up on the slope of the hill with an outer wall and a ditch, and the besiegers worked by sealing the valley mouths, cutting off the water and the roads and closing in; no transmitted account records the use of towers or battering rams on either side, so the difference between attack and defence lay almost entirely in endurance and supply, and since the Caucasian winter closes the passes with snow, every operation was crowded into the spring and summer campaigning season.
tactics: 伊比利亞一方延續馬其頓方陣的戰法：以密集縱隊作戰，前排長矛平舉、後排依次接手，靠整齊的推擠把對手壓垮，兩翼交給騎兵與弓兵掩護，攻勢一起便不給對手重整的時間；這正是卡面 dory 所代表的那套邏輯，只是到了公元五十年，長矛已加長成馬其頓式的矛林。包圍加爾尼時，拉達米斯托斯與密梯里達斯沒有強攻堡牆，而是切斷阿扎特河谷與通往埃里溫的南北道路，讓堡內守軍缺水缺糧，冬季再封住山道，把戰役拖成消耗戰；加爾尼堡居高臨下，又有厚牆與壕溝可依，所以圍攻拖到五十一年仍以圍方取勝收場。羅馬人此時的戰術不在於打仗，而在於避免打仗：卡帕多細亞總督用使節、條款與最後通牒在兩國之間選邊，把亞美尼亞的合法性與伊比利亞的人望捆綁在一起，同時讓伊比利亞不必獨力承擔帕提亞的壓力；羅馬在加爾尼只留守備隊與少量輔助兵，主力仍在卡帕多細亞與敘利亞一線待機。帕提亞的介入走的是另一條路：以騎兵為骨幹的遠征隊伍越過亞美尼亞高原，掠奪城邑與牧場，把邊境衝突升級成兩大帝國的角力。五十五年帕提亞的入侵被史家視為羅馬—帕提亞戰爭的開端，此後六十二年拉蘭底亞與提格利亞的戰鬥都是這條線的延伸。
tacticsEn: The Iberians carried on the Macedonian way of fighting: fighting in dense columns, with the spears of the front rank levelled and those of the ranks behind taking over in turn, so that a disciplined push bore the enemy down, the wings covered by cavalry and archers, and once the attack began the opponent was given no time to reform. That is precisely the logic the dory on the card stands for, except that by AD 50 the spear had been lengthened into the Macedonian forest of pikes. When they invested Garni, Rhadamistus and Mithridates did not assault the walls; they cut the Azat valley and the roads running north and south toward Erivan, so that the garrison inside suffered for water and grain, and in winter they closed the passes, turning the operation into a war of attrition. Garni stood on high ground with thick walls and a ditch to hold, so the siege dragged on through AD 51 and still ended in a victory for the besiegers. The Romans at this moment were not interested in fighting but in not fighting: the governor of Cappadocia used envoys, clauses and final ultimatums to pick a side between the two kingdoms, binding the legitimacy of Armenia to the prestige of Iberia and sparing Iberia the need to bear the Parthian pressure alone. Rome kept only a garrison and a few auxiliaries at Garni, with the main strength still waiting on the Cappadocian and Syrian lines. Parthia came in by a different road: expeditionary columns whose backbone was cavalry crossed the Armenian highlands, stripped the towns and pastures, and lifted a frontier quarrel into a trial of strength between two empires. The Parthian incursion of AD 55 is treated by historians as the opening of the Roman–Parthian war, and the fighting at Rhandeia and Tigranocerta in AD 62 is the extension of the same line.
data: 可核的數字不多，先說分期：這場戰爭在史料中不是一次持續的戰役，而是公元三十五至三十六年、四十七年、五十至五十一年、五十二至五十三年、五十四年、五十五年六段互有因果的衝突；卡面標的公元五十年落在第三段的起點，五十一年則是加爾尼之圍的年份。地理上加爾尼堡在北緯四十點一度、東經四十四點七度，阿扎特河與加爾尼河在此匯流，離今亞美尼亞首都埃里溫以北約三十餘公里；伊比利亞首都姆茨赫塔在北緯四十一度七分、東經四十四點八分，兩地同在高加索南麓，兵鋒可以沿谷地直來直去。兵力方面，亞美尼亞與伊比利亞都是中等規模的王國，野戰兵力當以千計、最多以萬計；羅馬在加爾尼只駐守備隊與輔助兵，帝國主力軍團配置在卡帕多細亞與敘利亞。以上推算有地形與制度上的依據，但沒有任何一份傳世文獻留下確切的兵員表，數字只宜當作量級看。真正傾盡兵力的是五十八至六十三年的羅馬—帕提亞戰爭：羅馬投入多個軍團與數萬輔助兵、騎兵，亞美尼亞與帕提亞聯軍亦以萬計。時間上整串衝突橫跨二十年，若只計五十至五十三年這一段主體，約四年。月份方面史料只記年份不記月日，卡面標一月，是沿用通行記法而非確考。
dataEn: There are few figures that can be checked, and the first of them is the division into phases. In the sources this war is not one continuous campaign but six causally linked conflicts: AD 35–36, AD 47, AD 50–51, AD 52–53, AD 54 and AD 55. The year AD 50 printed on the card falls at the opening of the third of them, while AD 51 is the year of the siege of Garni. Geographically, the fortress of Garni stands at 40.1 degrees north and 44.7 degrees east, where the Azat and the Garni rivers run together, some thirty-odd kilometres north of the modern Armenian capital of Erivan; the Iberian capital of Mtskheta lies at 41.7 degrees north and 44.8 degrees east. Both places sit on the southern flank of the Caucasus, and a force can move straight at the other along the valleys. On strength, Armenia and Iberia were middle-sized kingdoms, and their field armies can be reckoned in thousands and at most in tens of thousands; Rome held Garni with a garrison and auxiliaries only, with the main body of the imperial legions deployed in Cappadocia and Syria. Those estimates rest on the terrain and on how the armies were organised, but no transmitted text preserves a table of numbers, so they can only be read as orders of magnitude. The true concentration of forces came in the Roman–Parthian War of 58–63: Rome committed several legions together with tens of thousands of auxiliaries and cavalry, and the Armenian–Parthian armies were likewise counted in tens of thousands. In time the whole series of conflicts spans twenty years; taking only the central stretch of AD 50–53, about four. As for months, the sources record years but no dates, and the card gives January because that is the usual convention and not because it has been established.
cause: 打起來的直接原因，是亞美尼亞王位的繼承糾紛與伊比利亞王室的介入攪在一起。公元五十年前後，亞美尼亞的少年國王提格朗在繼母澤諾比亞的黨羽逼迫下失去王位、流亡羅馬；羅馬人一邊把這位少年視為合法君主，一邊又在背後扶植混合王族的另一支，拉達米斯托斯於是把法爾納瓦茲家的血統與羅馬的承認合併起來，兵鋒直指阿爾塔克薩塔。往深一層看，這是羅馬東方政策在亞美尼亞方向的一次押注：自龐培時代起，羅馬就把亞美尼亞當作對付帕提亞的第一道閘門，誰能決定亞美尼亞的國王，誰就控制通往高加索山隘與中亞的門戶；而亞美尼亞自己也想趁羅馬需要它的時候，把邊界從模糊的山地推向可防守的谷地，於是伊比利亞與亞美尼亞在加爾尼與阿拉克塞斯一線互相推擠。最後一層是帕提亞：它既不願看亞美尼亞完全倒向羅馬，也不能容許伊比利亞的勢力越過山脊，於是五十二年之後以出兵支援亞美尼亞，把原本兩國之間的邊界爭端拖成一場兩大帝國的代理人戰爭。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the fighting was the entanglement of a dispute over the Armenian succession with the intervention of the Iberian royal house. Around AD 50 the young Armenian king Tigranes was driven from his throne by the faction of his stepmother Zenobia and went into exile at Rome; the Romans, who on the one hand treated the boy as the legitimate monarch, on the other hand were quietly backing the other branch of the mixed dynasty, and Rhadamistus accordingly fused the blood of the Pharnavazids with the recognition of Rome and marched straight on Artaxata. At a deeper level this was a wager by the Roman eastern policy on the Armenian axis: since the days of Pompey, Rome had treated Armenia as the first gate against Parthia, and whoever decided who sat on the Armenian throne controlled the door to the Caucasian passes and to Central Asia. Armenia itself, for its part, wanted to use the moment while Rome needed it to push its frontier from ill-defined uplands onto defensible valleys, and so Iberia and Armenia pushed at one another along the line of Garni and the Araxes. The last layer is Parthia: it did not want to see Armenia turn wholly to Rome, nor could it allow Iberian power to cross the ridge, and so from AD 52 it came in with troops to support Armenia, dragging what had been a frontier quarrel between two kingdoms into a proxy war between two empires.
impact: 這場戰爭的結果，最終寫在亞美尼亞的王朝上。拉達米斯托斯兩度登位，把法爾納瓦茲系與提格蘭系揉成一個王朝；五十八年他死後，提里達底一世接手，六十三年他帶兵到羅馬，由皇帝尼祿加冕，六年後阿爾塔沙德家系復辟時，他仍是亞美尼亞國王。羅馬—帕提亞戰爭（五十八至六十三年）因此在起點上就是這場高加索衝突的延長，拉蘭底亞、提格利亞等戰役都是同一條邊界上的角力；到六十二年，羅馬與提里達底的聯軍在拉蘭底亞擊敗亞美尼亞與帕提亞聯軍，亞美尼亞的獨立性再受重創，羅馬重新接手東線的緩衝安排。另一層影響在兵制上：伊比利亞與亞美尼亞的步兵長期沿用本都—馬其頓的方陣傳統，長矛、密集縱隊與兩翼騎兵包抄成為這兩個高加索國家的標準打法，即使在羅馬人環伺的年代也沒有被放棄；直到公元五世紀末，亞美尼亞與格魯吉亞的步兵仍在使用長矛方陣。可以確定的是，這段歷史留下的文字極少，細節主要靠塔西陀《編年史》卷十三與卷十五的零星記載、狄奧尼修斯以及後世亞美尼亞編年史拼湊而成，很多年份與人物關係只能大致排定。
impactEn: The outcome of this war was written, in the end, on the Armenian dynasty. Rhadamistus reached the throne twice and kneaded the Pharnavazid and Tigranid lines into a single house; after his death in Iberia in AD 58, Tiridates I took over, came to Rome with his army in AD 63 and was crowned by the emperor Nero, and when the Artaxiad house was restored six years later he was still king of Armenia. The Roman–Parthian War of 58–63 was therefore, in its starting point, an extension of this Caucasian conflict, and the battles of Rhandeia and Tigranocerta were trials of strength on the same frontier. In AD 62 the Roman and Tiridatid coalition defeated the Armenian–Parthian army at Rhandeia, Armenia's independence was damaged once more, and Rome took the buffer arrangements on the eastern front back into its own hands. There was a second kind of effect, in the armaments: the infantry of Iberia and Armenia kept to the Pontic–Macedonian phalanx tradition for a long time, and long spears, dense columns and cavalry envelopment on the wings became the standard practice of these two Caucasian states, and were not abandoned even in the age when Rome surrounded them; the phalanx of pikes was still being used by Armenian and Georgian infantry as late as the end of the fifth century AD. What is certain is how little text this history has left: the details have to be pieced together from scattered notices in Tacitus's Annals, books thirteen and fifteen, from Dio, and from later Armenian chronicles, and many dates and relationships can only be fixed approximately.
result: 分階段的結果並不一致。三十五至三十六年、五十至五十一年與五十四年三段，記錄在案的都是伊比利亞方面的勝利；四十七年那一段是伊比利亞與羅馬共同的勝利；五十二至五十三年與五十五年兩段則是亞美尼亞—帕提亞方面的勝利，其中五十五年那一次被史家直接寫成羅馬與帕提亞之間的亞美尼亞戰爭的開端。五十一年最關鍵的一場是加爾尼之圍，結果也記為伊比利亞方取勝：拉達米斯托斯與密梯里達斯靠封鎖谷地、圍而不攻，最終迫使加爾尼守軍屈服，澤諾比亞也在這段戰事中死去，留下了被推入阿拉克塞斯河、又被牧人救起的傳說。就全局而言，亞美尼亞的國王人選並沒有解決：拉達米斯托斯在五十一與五十四年兩度失而復得，五十八年死於伊比利亞，提里達底一世接位之後仍要靠羅馬的軍力維持王位；真正為這條邊境帶來長時間安定的是六十二年之後羅馬確立的干預與六十六年之後的王朝復辟，而不是任何一方在高加索取得的戰場勝利。對卡面這件兵器而言，斯巴達長矛從未到過加爾尼，但它所代表的那套以長矛、盾牆與縱深決定戰局的方陣邏輯，恰恰在高加索的步兵裡延續了八百年。
resultEn: The results differ from phase to phase. For AD 35–36, AD 50–51 and AD 54, what is recorded is a victory for the Iberians; the phase of AD 47 was a joint Iberian and Roman success; the phases of AD 52–53 and AD 55 went to Armenia and Parthia, and the last of them is written down by historians as the opening of the Armenian war between Rome and Parthia. The most important action of AD 51 was the siege of Garni, and that too is recorded as an Iberian victory: Rhadamistus and Mithridates won by sealing the valley and investing rather than assaulting, and in the end the garrison of Garni gave way; Zenobia died in the course of these events, leaving behind the legend of the Araxes and the shepherds who pulled her out. In the larger picture the question of who should sit on the Armenian throne was not settled: Rhadamistus lost and regained it in AD 51 and AD 54, died in Iberia in AD 58, and Tiridates I, who succeeded him, still had to keep his throne with Roman troops behind it. What finally brought this frontier a long spell of quiet was the Roman intervention established after AD 62 and the restoration of the dynasty after AD 66, and not any battlefield victory won in the Caucasus by either side. As for the weapon on the card, the Spartan dory never came to Garni, but the logic it stands for, of long spears, shield walls and depth deciding a battle, carried on in the infantry of the Caucasus for eight hundred years.
